senses.definition: To feel pain, sorrow, or regret for what one has done or omitted to do; the cause for repenting may be indicated with "of".
senses.example: Marry in haste, repent at leisure.
wordFamily: marry in haste, repent at leisure

senses.definition: To be sorry for sin as morally evil, and to seek forgiveness; to cease to practice sin and to love.
senses.example: ... Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God, And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
wordFamily: marry in haste, repent at leisure

senses.definition: To feel pain on account of; to remember with sorrow.
senses.example: If Aljunied decides to go that way (to vote for the Workers' Party), well Aljunied has five years to live and repent.
wordFamily: marry in haste, repent at leisure

senses.definition: To be sorry for, to regret.
wordFamily: marry in haste, repent at leisure

senses.definition: To cause to have sorrow or regret.
senses.example: at that time she wolde nat, she seyde, for she was syke and myght nat ryde. "That me repentith," seyde the kynge[…].
wordFamily: marry in haste, repent at leisure

senses.definition: To cause (oneself) to feel pain or regret.
senses.example:
But if that I knewe what his name hight,
For clatering of me I would him ſone quight;
For his falſe lying, of that I ſpake never,
I could make him ſhortly repent him forever: […]
wordFamily: marry in haste, repent at leisure

senses.example: The Lord hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
wordFamily: marry in haste, repent at leisure
